- Explained that a steeper position-time line means greater velocity.
- An earlier slope/acceleration mix-up was not explicitly revisited; teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Asha practised slopes, areas, and graph meaning with Ira. Ira correctly used position change divided by time, explained why a steeper position-time line shows greater velocity, and identified a horizontal line as no change in position. There was an earlier mix-up between slope and acceleration that was not explicitly corrected later; at home, ask Ira to label whether each question uses slope or area and whether it is an x-t or v-t graph.
